business_summary.text: Cemindia Projects Limited (formerly ITD Cementation India Limited) is an engineering, procurement and construction company focused on civil infrastructure such as ports, roads, metro and marine works, largely for Adani-group entities.

call_points.text: FY27 revenue growth guidance maintained at 25%.
Q1 order inflow ₹8,519 Cr; July added ₹1,247 Cr; L1 about ₹990 Cr.
Vadhvan port execution has not started; timing is not in the company's control.
Labour shortage is a challenge across the Indian construction industry.
Data centre work in progress totals around 320-400 MW, including five projects in Navi Mumbai.
**Order inflow target:** Company aims to secure ₹25,000 Cr in new orders in FY27.
**FY27 Capex:** Planned capex guided at ₹350 Cr to ₹400 Cr, including purchasing new TBMs.
**Data centers:** Secured ₹3,000 Cr in data center contracts so far, primarily from the promoter group.
**Vadhvan project:** Vadhvan Port works remain slow-moving due to local issues beyond company control.

guidance.statement: Revenue growth of 20% to 25% in FY27
Sustainable annual EBITDA margin of 10.5% to 11%
Order inflow target of around ₹25,000 Cr for FY27

operating_notes.text: FY26 other income of ₹176.96 Cr was 21.6% of pre-tax profit of ₹817.62 Cr.
The Group operates in a single business segment, Engineering and Construction, mainly in India.
Implementation of four Labour Codes added ₹16.18 Cr to defined benefit obligations, recognised in FY26 employee benefits expense.
Mobilization advances stood at ₹1,400 Cr as of March 2026, of which 90% is interest-free.
Secured ₹3,000 Cr in data center projects within the promoter group.
Total bidding pipeline is ₹70,000 Cr, with Adani Group accounting for 35% to 40%.
FY26 consolidated revenue from operations was ₹10,060.58 Cr, with India contributing ₹9,712.01 Cr and outside India ₹348.57 Cr.
The company invested in 2,600 equity shares of Morsagar Bisalpur Water Limited, a 26% associate, during FY26.
FY26 related-party transactions included ₹992.72 Cr of income from Adani Road Transport and ₹350.47 Cr from Adani Renewable Energy Forty Two.
Work in hand about ₹31,000 Cr, of which the Adani group is around 53%.
Bid pipeline close to ₹90,000 Cr with a hit ratio of about 15%; marine pipeline about ₹15,000 Cr.
Data centre work in progress around 320-400 MW, including five projects in Navi Mumbai.
Opened Qualified Institutional Placement with a floor price of ₹1,158.58 per share.
Closed QIP allocating 1,26,35,379 shares at ₹1,108 per share, a 4.37% discount to the ₹1,158.58 floor price.

timeline.summary: Cemindia Projects Limited schedules Analysts/Institutional Investor Conference Call on April 30, 2026, at 10:00 AM (IST) for Q4FY26 audited results, featuring Mr. Jayanta Basu (MD), Mr. Nitesh Sharma (CFO), and Mr. Rahul Agarwal (Head IR).
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,973.49 Cr, net profit ₹242.17 Cr (+112.6% YoY).
Cemindia Projects Limited uploaded the audio recording of its Analyst/Investor Conference Call on 2026-04-30 at 10:00 AM for Q4FY26 results.
Cemindia held its Q4FY26 earnings call, guiding 20-25% revenue growth for FY27 on a ₹29,000 Cr order book and ₹70,000 Cr pipeline.
Cemindia Projects Limited’s Board of Directors, led by **Rahul Neogi**, recommended a final dividend of ₹3 per equity share on 171,787,584 shares for FY2026, pending AGM approval.
Cemindia Projects announced on May 21, 2026, that the Vijayawada Court discharged the company and its former employee in a 2018 bribery case.

Cemindia filed its FY26 annual report showing consolidated revenue of ₹10,060.58 Cr (+8.8%) and PAT of ₹597.73 Cr (+60.3%), with an unmodified audit opinion and AGM notice seeking approval for ₹5,113 Cr of FY27 related-party transactions.
On May 29, 2026, Cemindia Projects issued the notice for its 48th Annual General Meeting scheduled for June 27, 2026.
Promoter entities Renew Exim DMCC and Valiant Investment FZCO renamed to Renew Exim FZCO and retained name, respectively, on 2026-06-03.
Cemindia Projects opened its QIP with a floor price of ₹1,158.58 per share.
Crisil Ratings assigned Cemindia Projects a Crisil AA/Stable long-term and Crisil A1+ short-term rating on its bank loan facilities.
Cemindia Projects closed its Qualified Institutional Placement, allocating 1.26 crore shares at ₹1,108 each.
